rows.label: bf02120140_0010
rows.name:
Now then, is there no
one else brave enough?

rows.label: bf02120140_0020
rows.name:
Use that courage of yours
to support Superbia's future!

rows.label: bf02120140_0030
rows.name:
Of course, there's more than a monthly salary.
You'll even receive a pension!

rows.label: bf02120140_0040
rows.name:
Earn enough merit, and you could even
be granted a title of nobility!

rows.label: bf02120140_0050
rows.name:
Show your courage for His Majesty Nefer,
the great Emperor of Superbia!

rows.label: bf02120140_0060
rows.name: Come, step forward, hero of tomorrow!

rows.label: bf02120140_0100
rows.name:
Lately, they've been recruiting Drivers
all around the city.

rows.label: bf02120140_0110
rows.name:
Those able to resonate are dwindling by the day.
I suppose there were none among the soldiers, either.

rows.label: bf02120140_0120
rows.name:
What do you mean by recruiting
Drivers and resonance?
